fieldValues.title: A website's own package links its block types to its components; the site editor is a generic srs-web shell
fieldValues.decision_question: Where does the knowledge of which component draws a website block type, and which fields stay off the site, live once the site editor moves into srs-web?
fieldValues.context: The muDemocracy site editor was a separate app; type-to-component and brief-field knowledge was repeated as string matches in its model, the site's export script and its renderer, and two brief lists disagreed. Holon muDemocracy.org#418 moves the editor into srs-web, which cannot see a site's code. srs-web ADR-029 (srs-web#680, PR #683) records the implementation.
fieldValues.friction: Every new block kind or page needed edits in several places; the editor could not offer block types or tell a brief from copy without a code change.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered:
The site's package (chosen): one View per site component, the site Composition (tagged `site`) dispatching each type to its View; field views give order and visibility (displayHint brief, setting, key); a Theme gives the look.
A site registry in srs-web code: a second copy of what the package states, and a srs-web change per site.
Keep the prototype as a separate app: drifts at each pin, no storage, relay or hosting.
Do nothing: three string-matched copies remain.
fieldValues.key_requirements: The generic core (srs-web src/lib/site/*.ts) names no site; a site's own logic lives in src/lib/site/<site>/ and is never imported by the core (layers test). The site export is a temporary TS projection until srs-rust#1553 moves it into the core.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A website's own SRS package is the one link between its block types and its components: a View per component, a Composition tagged `site` whose typeDispatch maps type to View, and a Theme. The srs-web site shell and the site's build both read it. Site-specific behaviour is a separate layer the generic core never imports.
fieldValues.rationale: The package is the only artefact both the generic editor and the site can read; the spec already had every piece (View, typeDispatch, displayHint, remote Theme stylesheet) and the WASM bindings already read them, so no core change was needed. Owner direction: vignettes 4adc5965 and 7e87af63.
fieldValues.revisit_when: A second site adopts the editor (extract a shared site package); srs-rust#1553 lands (the export moves into the core); or a site needs a field role the View cannot express.
fieldValues.next_steps: srs-web#680 PR B (the shell), muDemocracy.org#415 (the site build calls exportSite), srs-rust#1553.
